title: Personal Team Selection (.specify/jira/personal.yml)
description: Human-owned, gitignored, per-clone, OPTIONAL file: never written by any script, never required for any workflow (FR-011). The `team` value MUST match a catalogue team id; an unknown value produces a located error naming this file and listing the valid ids. `override` passes exactly the catalogue-entry validation and its use is reported in every feature-creation output (FR-012). Credential-shaped values in any string are refused without echoing (FR-018). Gitignore coverage of this path is enforced by the config ceremony's gitignore effect (FR-019). Presented as JSON Schema; the on-disk file is YAML.

team.description: The developer's selected catalogue team id.

override.description: Exceptional, auditable convention override (FR-012). Same validation rules as teams-catalogue.schema.json fields.
